discovery.purpose: Inventory of real After Effects control tools and the operations they actually implement in source (not README claims).
discovery.scope: GitHub repository search (gh search repos) for MCP servers controlling Adobe After Effects, plus repos already cited by ae-devtools/ae-a8n research (BenZed/after-effects, ido-bata/Ae_LayerNote, ido-bata/ae-a8n) and this repository's experiments/runtime-bridge.
discovery.selectionCriteria: Examined when the repository contains readable source that reaches After Effects (ExtendScript/CEP/bridge) and is a plausible control tool. Top search results by activity were cloned; deep extraction was performed where the tool surface was machine-locatable. Every examined tool records commit + license + observation date.
outOfScope: closed-source or unlicensed binaries without readable source
tools not reached by the search terms (the population is open; no completeness claim)
real-host execution (source review only — see ae-devtools #13-#19)
sources: specs/ae-capability-coverage/research.md §4 parity discovery protocol (read from branch 6)

refreshProcedure.action: Re-run the discovery search and diff the candidate set against snapshot/tools.json + NOT_EXAMINED.
Fetch each pinned clone and report upstream commits newer than the pinned SHA.
Verify committed output is byte-identical to a fresh run and every cited file+line resolves.
Accept an upstream update only after review: re-pin the commit in scripts/registry.ts (or `bun run refresh -- --update <tool>`), re-run steps 3-4, commit the delta.

Add a newly discovered tool: clone into .reference/<dir>, add a ToolDef (commit/license/status) to scripts/registry.ts, add an adapter under scripts/adapters/, add its semantic ids to scripts/semantics.ts, re-run steps 3-4.
